fanChallenge.title: Fan Challenge · BetInsight
fanChallenge.preview: Preview mode · No real Fan Challenge predictions are saved.
fanChallenge.brandSubtitle: Your sports knowledge counts all season long
fanChallenge.heroTitle: 6 questions. One leaderboard. One season champion.
fanChallenge.heroLead: Submit your Bundesliga predictions for free. Every correct answer earns points. The earlier you make your prediction, the higher your points factor can be. All six questions count toward the same Fan Challenge leaderboard.
fanChallenge.challengeCopy: Choose one of the six questions. You can submit exactly one binding prediction per question.
fanChallenge.oneTip: One prediction per question. Once submitted, your selection cannot be changed.
fanChallenge.privacy: No email address or real name is shown on the leaderboard.
fanChallenge.myTipsCopy: All six questions count toward your season points.
fanChallenge.myTipsEmpty: No Fan Challenge prediction submitted yet.
fanChallenge.trendCopy: For each question, we currently show the most selected answer among BetInsight fans. Later, this view can be expanded to the Top 3.
fanChallenge.leaderboardCopy: The leaderboard is based on evaluated season questions. If points are tied, the earlier first prediction ranks higher.
fanChallenge.prizesCopy: One shared pool for all six questions – not 500 Units per question.
fanChallenge.rule1Copy: No Units are used to participate.
fanChallenge.rule2Copy: Each question can be answered once, independently.
fanChallenge.rule3Copy: The earlier you submit your prediction, the higher the possible points factor.
fanChallenge.rule4Copy: All points from correct predictions are added to one shared leaderboard.
fanChallenge.footnote: Free Units from the Fan Challenge are bonus/gift Units for use within BetInsight and are not intended for sale on the Unit Exchange. Final prizes are credited only after the season evaluation has been completed.
fanChallenge.noQuestion: There is currently no open Fan Challenge question.
fanChallenge.trendNoTips: No predictions for this question yet.
fanChallenge.leaderboardEmpty: No season question has been evaluated yet. The leaderboard starts with the first evaluated results.
fanChallenge.previewDisabled: Preview: prediction submission is intentionally disabled here.
fanChallenge.missingAccess: Please open the Fan Challenge from your signed-in BetInsight profile.
fanChallenge.loadError: The Fan Challenge could not be loaded.
fanChallenge.confirm: Your prediction “{{choice}}” will be saved permanently for this question. Continue?
fanChallenge.submitError: The prediction could not be saved.
